name: vgc-model-league
description: Research harness for language-model decisions across VGC drafts and battles

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && vite build --logLevel warn
scripts.build:frozen-circuit: node tools/setup-showdown.mjs --check && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-circuit', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.frozen-circuit.json
scripts.test:circuit-package: cd environments/vgc_circuit_v1 && uv sync --locked --group test && uv run --locked --group test pytest
scripts.typecheck: node tools/setup-showdown.mjs --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
scripts.build:site: vite build --mode static --logLevel warn && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('artifacts/public/site', 'dist/gui-static/data', { recursive: true })"
scripts.publish:site: pnpm run build && pnpm run export-site && node tools/publish-site.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node -e 'for (const d of ["runs", "records"]) require("node:fs").mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true })' && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=300000 dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test: pnpm run check && pnpm run check:artifacts && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:frozen-circuit && pnpm run test:unit
